title_zh: 试吃后选一包清淡薯片

scenario.goal_zh: 询问口味并在甜咸零食之间完成选择。

context_zh: 顾客在零食柜台比较样品，按口味选择小包装。
author: author-phase03-b

sentences.speaker: Customer Mina
sentences.text: Are these samples free? I cannot decide between something sweet and something salty.

sentences.speaker: Shopkeeper Hugo
sentences.text: Yes. You can try a chip from this bowl. The candy samples are in the small paper cups.

sentences.speaker: Customer Mina
sentences.text: Thank you. That chip is a bit too salty for me.

sentences.speaker: Shopkeeper Hugo
sentences.text: We have a plain version with less salt. Would you like to try it?

sentences.speaker: Customer Mina
sentences.text: Yes, please. That is much better. I will take one small bag of the plain ones.

sentences.speaker: Shopkeeper Hugo
sentences.text: Here you are. I will ring that up for you.

targets.sense_zh: 少量；a bit 表示稍微
